trumpWatch.title: SUMMIT DELIVERED: US-China trade truce extended two months to January 10, 2027
trumpWatch.detail: Bessent announced the extension of the 'Busan Agreement' in a Fox News interview as Xi's plane arrived Wednesday — two months, not the one-year extension some expected: 'to secure more time to see what we can accomplish in the economic sector.' Bessent flagged ~$17bn of Chinese ag-purchase commitments (soybeans) running 'slightly behind schedule' and pressed China to implement more comprehensively.

trumpWatch.title: Thursday bilateral: 'tremendous strides'; AI institutionalized as the centerpiece track; Taiwan and Iran raised by Xi
trumpWatch.detail: Bilateral ran past 1:30pm ET. Xi: 'even greater scope for cooperation than competition' on AI, which must stay 'always under human control'; asked the US to oppose Taiwan independence and handle the question 'with prudence' (Xinhua); backed a US-Iran return to the June 14-point MOU. Trump posted AI 'will be a big topic of discussion, but I want to leave it exactly where it is.' Two pandas (Ping Ping, Fu Shuang) to Zoo Atlanta. Dinner: Huang, Altman, Brockman, Pichai, Zuckerberg, Jeff Yass, three SCOTUS justices; toast honored Nixon-Zhou 1972 'Toast to Peace'. No formal AI communique or US-side Taiwan language as of the dinner.

trumpWatch.title: Oil re-spikes: WTI +2.42% to $94.39 (intraday $97) — Houthi missiles on Saudi vs US-Iran deal reports
trumpWatch.detail: Iran-allied Houthis fired missiles at Saudi cities including Yanbu (key Red Sea export terminal) and Taif; prices trimmed from $97 on reports US and Iranian negotiators are exploring lifting naval blockades on Hormuz tankers and easing US sanctions. Only 10 commodity vessels transited Hormuz Wednesday (10-day avg 17); Saudi's workaround war-risk insurance now nearly as costly as the strait; US diesel at a record high; Senate narrowly rejected a nonbinding end-the-war measure. India sold off hard (Sensex -1,200, India VIX +25%) as Brent topped $105.

trumpWatch.title: Rates: 10y prints 5.21% — fresh 2007 high; 30y highest since 2004; October hike odds ~64%
trumpWatch.detail: Oil re-spike plus hot flash PMIs plus hawkish Fed-speak pushed the 10y up 9bp to 5.21% (TE daily print; ^TNX 5.16% at the close) and the 30y above 5.44%, its highest since 2004. Markets now price ~64% odds of a 25bp October Fed hike and >48% for December. Thursday's four central banks: SNB held at 0.00%; Riksbank/Banxico previews pointed to holds; Norges was a coin-flip (outcomes not fully captured).

trumpWatch.title: Rare earths — the unresolved card: shipments falling at fastest pace since the pandemic
trumpWatch.detail: Oxford Economics (via CNN): Chinese rare-earth shipments are falling at the fastest volume pace since the pandemic; 'Beijing appears willing to test the limits of the truce. It has deliberately kept license approvals slow and selective.' No export-flow resolution was announced at the summit — now the top residual failure script, ahead of Taiwan rhetoric.

trumpWatch.title: Today's slate: Xi's visit concludes (closing statement possible); China Mid-Autumn holiday; US Durable Goods
trumpWatch.detail: Friday: the state visit's final day — watch for a closing statement or joint communique; mainland China shut for Mid-Autumn (HK open, southbound flows closed); US Durable Goods (Aug) is the only major US print.
